policy.platformVerified: Only interfaceLanguages entries with verified_* labels are verified platform language facts. Observed subsets are lower bounds, not exhaustive lists.
policy.regionalSupplement: For unverified platforms use selected market main language, label 地区补充, and keep brand names/model codes untranslated. Do not assert platform interface support.
policy.queryGeneration: Fixed union: verified platform languages + regional languages + English. Brand names are not translated.
policy.globalPlatforms: All verified supported languages included; shared-query duplicates can be identified by their source query.
policy.variants: Preserve zh-Hant versus zh-Hans, and country flags separate from language code.
